=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text on "On the "
text day " day of Christmas,\nMy true love sent to me:\n"
text last "And a partridge in a pear tree."
text days "first\nsecond\nthird\nfourth\nfifth\nsixth\nseventh\neighth\nninth\ntenth\neleventh\ntwelfth\n"
text gifts "A partridge in a pear tree.\nTwo turtle doves,\nThree french hens,\nFour calling birds,\nFive golden rings,\nSix geese a-laying,\nSeven swans a-swimming,\nEight maids a-milking,\nNine ladies dancing,\nTen lords a-leaping,\nEleven pipers piping,\nTwelve drummers drumming,\n"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note word writes element k of a newline-terminated list, without the newline
fn word t view uchar * k ulong to void
s = ulong 0
m = ulong 0
for i ulong len t
if eq get t i 10
if eq m k
emit part t s sub i s
ret
end
m = add m 1
s = add i 1
end
end
trap 9
end
note verse d lists gifts d down to 0; from the second day on the partridge line starts "And a"
fn verse d ulong to void
emit on
word days d
emit day
for k ulong add d 1
g = sub d k
if and eq g 0 gt d 0
emit last
else
word gifts g
end
emit nl
end
end
fn main to int
for d ulong 12
if gt d 0
emit nl
end
verse d
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
On the first day of Christmas,
My true love sent to me:
A partridge in a pear tree.

On the second day of Christmas,
My true love sent to me:
Two turtle doves,
And a partridge in a pear tree.

On the third day of Christmas,
My true love sent to me:
Three french hens,
Two turtle doves,
And a partridge in a pear tree.

...
Eight maids a-milking,
Seven swans a-swimming,
Six geese a-laying,
Five golden rings,
Four calling birds,
Three french hens,
Two turtle doves,
And a partridge in a pear tree.
</pre>
